user.title: Bathroom – basics
user.description: Select the bathroom temperature and humidity sensors, the floor heating pump relay and the towel radiator smart plug.

boiler.title: Boiler (OpenTherm)
boiler.description: Heat is requested from the boiler only when the house heating is NOT running. If the house heats, only the pump is switched. The boiler heats the floor until the return water reaches the set temperature.

data.house_heating_entity: House heating running? (OTGW thermostat / binary sensor)

data_description.gateway_id: The id given when setting up OpenTherm Gateway.
data_description.return_temp_sensor: OTGW 'Return Water Temperature' sensor (disabled by default).

extra.title: Extras (optional)
extra.description: Works without these, but they save energy.

data.towel_nominal_watts: Towel radiator nominal power (if not metered)

data_description.outdoor_humidity_sensor: Ventilation is only suggested when outside air is drier.

error.entity_required: Select a boiler entity for this mode.

abort.already_configured: This towel radiator is already configured.
